pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

refloor.why: sheet_proxy already floored a FOOT: the -x front claw tip (-1.13, -0.60, 0.000); the +x claws sit 0.070 u up (the repose plants them). The window (front toes y -0.7..0.3, |x| >= 0.25) only confirms the foot contact and rescales x0.9849 (5.90 / 5.991) to the sheet front height (sheet front 5.90 vs side 5.99 u, +1.5 %)

dense.why: the head / face: beak (tip (0.030, -2.074, 3.784) stage frame), mask plate + forehead spike (top (0.040, -0.681, 5.900)), both eyes, crest feathers (proxy sha 793ce80b x0.9849); vg_weight 0.3 so the eye / tip boxes sit denser
the +x eye (pupil centroid [0.3907, -0.8, 4.6619] stage frame; eyeball r 0.19 u): eyeball bulge / socket on their own faces so the crisp eye paint sits on the eye's own outline
the -x eye (pupil centroid [-0.3278, -0.8045, 4.6604] stage frame; eyeball r 0.19 u): eyeball bulge / socket on their own faces so the crisp eye paint sits on the eye's own outline
the forehead spike tip (0.040, -0.681, 5.900): kept sharp

recolour3d.name: mask_beak_yellow
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE (2): the beak / mask / spike read brownish: proxy head yellow (visible texels, front + side) median 193,150,86 (L* 64.8) vs the sheet's chip 215,170,94 (sheet head yellow front 234,197,130 / side 204,167,109). Head yellow texels (z >= 3.4, b* >= 22; the eyes are excluded and painted below) to the chip lifted for the AO multiply, the proxy's shading kept at reduced contrast (gamma 0.35, clip 0.8..1.08; run 1 at 0.6 / 0.7..1.12 left brown smudges on the forehead plate) so it reads as ONE clean yellow shape. Legs untouched: the proxy legs (201,154,89) already sit on the sheet's legs (front 199,154,92 / side 185,142,85)

recolour3d.name: tone_white_blue
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE (1) TONE: the proxy reads dark navy and dull next to the sheet's bright layered blues and clear whites. Visible proxy feather texels L* p5/25/50/75/95 [17.7, 27.7, 35.8, 53.5, 81.5] vs the sheet front + side [17.1, 26.2, 38.6, 56.2, 86.1]; b* p10 -37.3 vs -44.1 (the proxy is less saturated). A 2D QUANTILE map (azure_scale_mage method): 6 L* bands (brightest first) x 3 b* thirds per band, each class to the sheet's colour at the same L* quantile band and b* third, the proxy's feather detail kept as a luma ratio; the eyes (boxes) and the yellow (b* > 15) keep their own specs; claws (z < 0.42) untouched. | proxy L* 71.0..101.0 (quantiles 87..100 % of the visible feather texels, front + side, eyes / yellow / claws out), b* -110.0..-7.3 (this band's blue third; proxy median [176, 182, 201]) -> the sheet's same L* quantile band (front + side masks, L* 75.5..100.0) and same b* third (median [186, 192, 211]), x1.10 for the AO multiply; gamma = the sheet / proxy log-luma spread q10..q90

light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself (the proxy's feather flaps are inner shells that black-hole AO rays; spike_beak / vulture lesson); ray length 0.2 u and texels under 0.04 refilled from their neighbours so the basecolor stays near the albedo
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner shells under the feather flaps) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight (spike_beak idiom)
light.uv_island_margin_why: the feather-flap low unwraps into thousands of islands; the default margin starves the atlas (storm_bear / vulture_creature idiom)

rig.spine_why: the body midline is x 0 (slab mid-x z 0.5..4.0: -0.009..+0.005; back-edge centroid -0.03..+0.03); neck root (0, 0.05, 4.15); the head pivot sits between the eyes (eye midpoint x 0.031) and the head bone runs 1.0 u along the FACE direction (perpendicular to the pupil-centre line, yaw 0.36 deg), so the repose heading turns the face straight ahead

chains.name: leg
chains.why: leg slab centroids (yellow texels, stage frame): z 1.38 (+-0.58, 0.62), z 0.98 (+-0.66, 0.57), z 0.59 (+-0.78, 0.42), ankle z 0.42 (+-0.8, 0.38), front toes (y -0.44, z 0.2, x +-0.99); hip inside the body at z 1.9. The pair is mirror-symmetric as generated (centroid differences <= 0.05 u); the +x claws hang 0.070 u above the floor

chains.name: tail
chains.why: the short layered tail on the midline (back edge |x| < 0.3: y 1.84 at z 2.3 -> 2.0 at z 1.1, tip z ~0.7; x -0.04..0.0): centred as generated, a chain so it can sway / be posed

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + height are the open artist questions): idle = breathe + the kit's tail sway; walk = a stalking bird step (leg swing 8: batch lesson, the kit walk dips the feet below the floor)

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: a symmetric rest pose. The legs are already near-mirror (joint differences <= 0.05 u) but the +x claws hang 0.070 u above the floor: both legs carried onto their mean, both feet planted on z 0

targets.heading: -y
targets.why: the head straight ahead: the face (perpendicular to the pupil-centre line) points 0.36 deg off -y; the neck takes half, the head the rest; the head is RIGID (below)

rigid.why: the head (mask plate, spike, both eyes, crest feathers) moves as ONE rigid body with the head bone: never deformed or re-sculpted; the eye paint rides on the UVs
the long beak (tip z 3.78) rides rigidly with the head too

config._doc: LIGHT finish of the raw Pixal3D proxy (seed 56, sha 793ce80b) + the unit note (rank-matched tone, one clean yellow mask, crisp large eyes) + the 2026-10-17 symmetric rest pose by repose (legs mean + planted, head straight, rigid face). Points: stage-1 frame (the feet already on the floor, x0.9849 to the sheet front height 5.90), sheet units; -y = front, +x = the unit's left.

units: sheet units: 1 unit = 100 px of the reference sheet; floor z = 0

refloor.rule: sheet_proxy put the floor at the lowest point (a tail curl): the feet hung z0 above it; floor moved to the feet, then scaled to the sheet front height

solid.rule: LIGHT: watertight remesh only (no smoothing / straighten / symmetrise / cuts); the surface sits min_half_thickness x step = 0.0098 u outside the proxy

colour.mode: light: the proxy texture as generated

recolour3d.name: mask_beak_yellow
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE (2): the beak / mask / spike read brownish: proxy head yellow (visible texels, front + side) median 193,150,86 (L* 64.8) vs the sheet's chip 215,170,94 (sheet head yellow front 234,197,130 / side 204,167,109). Head yellow texels (z >= 3.4, b* >= 22; the eyes are excluded and painted below) to the chip lifted for the AO multiply, the proxy's shading kept at reduced contrast (gamma 0.35, clip 0.8..1.08; run 1 at 0.6 / 0.7..1.12 left brown smudges on the forehead plate) so it reads as ONE clean yellow shape. Legs untouched: the proxy legs (201,154,89) already sit on the sheet's legs (front 199,154,92 / side 185,142,85)

recolour3d.name: tone_white_blue
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE (1) TONE: the proxy reads dark navy and dull next to the sheet's bright layered blues and clear whites. Visible proxy feather texels L* p5/25/50/75/95 [17.7, 27.7, 35.8, 53.5, 81.5] vs the sheet front + side [17.1, 26.2, 38.6, 56.2, 86.1]; b* p10 -37.3 vs -44.1 (the proxy is less saturated). A 2D QUANTILE map (azure_scale_mage method): 6 L* bands (brightest first) x 3 b* thirds per band, each class to the sheet's colour at the same L* quantile band and b* third, the proxy's feather detail kept as a luma ratio; the eyes (boxes) and the yellow (b* > 15) keep their own specs; claws (z < 0.42) untouched. | proxy L* 71.0..101.0 (quantiles 87..100 % of the visible feather texels, front + side, eyes / yellow / claws out), b* -110.0..-7.3 (this band's blue third; proxy median [176, 182, 201]) -> the sheet's same L* quantile band (front + side masks, L* 75.5..100.0) and same b* third (median [186, 192, 211]), x1.10 for the AO multiply; gamma = the sheet / proxy log-luma spread q10..q90

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 18000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

ao_fill.rule: AO < below = a bake origin inside the proxy soup: refilled from the covered valid 3x3 neighbours ring by ring (opt-in light.ao_fill_below)

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

stretch_all.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

repose.rule: LBS with the contract rig's weights (+ rigid pins), yaw-only straightening (+ lift), applied as rest

stretch_leg.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_neck_head.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

self_intersections.rule: intersecting triangle pairs sharing no vertex (BVH overlap)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)
